**Status:** Certified<br>
**Keywords:** Round, Raster<br>

**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.RasterValueRounder`

|---|---|---|---|---|

| `pPattern` | String |  |  | The rounding pattern, as 0.00 for two decimals. |
